content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka Cluster Supervisor
content_sections.text: NRLM Karnataka (Sanjeevini - KSRLPS) operates under the National Rural Livelihoods Mission to promote sustainable community institutions and livelihood opportunities in rural areas. The Cluster Supervisor role provides overall leadership at the cluster level for the development and sustainability of community institutions in Mandya district, Krishnarajpet taluka.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following eligibility criteria specified for the Cluster Supervisor post: Essential Qualification: Graduate Experience Required: Minimum 2 years post qualification relevant experience. Language Skills: Reading, writing & speaking skills in Kannada & English. Computer Knowledge: Knowledge of working with computers. Age Limit: Minimum age of 18 years and maximum age of 45 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary or remuneration for the Cluster Supervisor post is Rs. 18000.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Cluster Supervisor Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities assigned to the Cluster Supervisor include: Undertake field visits proactively. Work in close coordination with TMMU / TPM to implement planned activities in the cluster / (sub block). Identify and facilitate the process of organizing and inclusion of women, vulnerable communities (differently abled, SC / STs and other under privileged sections) and strengthening them into functional community level institutions. Facilitate activities relating to livelihoods planning, micro credit meetings, micro credit plan development and CIF utilization among communities. Liaison for service delivery of government entitlement and social safety net schemes in the cluster. Enhance access to entitlements and schemes to community level institutions through convergence. Ensure clean data entered into the MIS at TMMU level in a timely manner. Submit MPRs, QPRs and other relevant reports. Liaison with PRI institutions, line departments and other non – government organizations. Take up any other task as allocated by competent authority at BMMU.
